title: Divorce Party International Ltd. — financial reconstruction
preparationStatus: Complete AI-prepared case; personal student review pending; evidence limitations unresolved.

basis.description: Known-evidence scenario, not unqualified final accounts. Inventory follows stated consumption; missing insurance is not invented; opening completeness assumptions are explicit. VAT and corporate income tax are outside this classroom case.
assumptions: No residual opening receivables beyond EUR35,000 collected.
Opening supplier payable EUR45,000 inferred from purchases, payments and confirmed closing balances.
No other omitted opening assets, liabilities or equity movements; opening equity EUR170,000 is conditional.
No unreported operating accruals/prepayments beyond those identified.
EUR24,000 depreciation estimate used pending original schedule.
No disposal provision without evidence of a present obligation; EUR2,000 future cash exposure disclosed.

reconciliations.note: Opening completeness and inventory base assumptions apply.

reconciliations.title: Insurance movement
reconciliations.formula: Missing opening prepaid insurance + premiums − consumed cover = missing closing balance
reconciliations.note: No supported numerical reconciliation is possible.

uncertainties.title: Inventory differs by EUR9,000
uncertainties.description: The usable count is EUR121,000. The movement schedule gives EUR112,000. No evidence identifies the incorrect input.
uncertainties.base: Retain stated EUR405,000 consumption and show EUR112,000 provisional closing stock.
uncertainties.alternative: If consumption was EUR396,000, inventory, profit and equity rise EUR9,000. If opening stock was EUR89,000, inventory and opening equity rise EUR9,000 without changing period profit. An unrecorded purchase could instead affect liabilities.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Signed recount, stock ledger, purchase cut-off and consumption records.

uncertainties.title: Insurance evidence is missing
uncertainties.description: The template asks for insurance movements and consumption, but the supplied files do not give policy costs, payments, opening prepayments or closing cover.
uncertainties.base: Insurance amount is null. EUR65,000 profit is before any unidentified insurance expense.
uncertainties.alternative: A supported period expense I reduces profit and equity by I; the counter-entry depends on whether cover was prepaid or unpaid. No finite range is justified.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Insurance policy, invoices, payment records and opening prepaid-expense ledger.

uncertainties.title: Opening balances are only partly supplied
uncertainties.description: EUR35,000 opening AR, EUR45,000 opening supplier payables and EUR170,000 opening equity are conditional inferences, not a signed opening trial balance.
uncertainties.base: Assume no residual opening receivables or other omitted assets, liabilities or movements. Conditional closing equity is EUR125,000.
uncertainties.alternative: Unknown opening balances can change assets, liabilities and equity; a balanced model does not prove completeness.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Opening trial balance and AR/AP subledgers; equity and prepaid schedules.

uncertainties.title: Disposal quote does not establish an obligation
uncertainties.description: The damaged goods are worth zero. A separate EUR2,000 disposal quote does not by itself demonstrate a reporting-date obligation.
uncertainties.base: Recognize the EUR22,000 stock loss; disclose EUR2,000 future cash exposure without a disposal provision.
uncertainties.alternative: If a present obligation is established, profit and equity fall EUR2,000 and liabilities rise EUR2,000. No reporting-date cash effect.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Applicable obligation, committed disposal contract or other evidence establishing a present duty.

uncertainties.title: Legal claim estimate is a range
uncertainties.description: Counsel gives a probable claim with EUR25,000 best estimate and EUR20,000–30,000 range.
uncertainties.base: Accrue EUR25,000; no cash payment by reporting date.
uncertainties.alternative: The range alone moves provisional profit to EUR60,000–70,000. Combined stock-consumption, disposal and legal scenarios span EUR58,000–79,000 before unknown insurance; this is not a confidence interval.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Updated counsel assessment and eventual settlement.

uncertainties.title: Depreciation estimate lacks its schedule
uncertainties.description: The asset workbook cites EUR24,000 depreciation but supplies neither useful lives nor the independent schedule.
uncertainties.base: Use EUR24,000 provisionally; net PPE EUR191,000.
uncertainties.alternative: Each EUR1 increase in depreciation reduces profit, PPE and equity by EUR1 without affecting cash. No defensible numerical range.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Asset-level useful lives, residual values, method and depreciation schedule.

uncertainties.title: Monthly payroll cannot be reconstructed
uncertainties.description: The bank shows one Jan–Aug aggregate of EUR231,000. No monthly breakdown supports D014–D021.
uncertainties.base: Report the aggregate and leave individual months unknown.
uncertainties.alternative: Dividing equally into eight months would invent evidence. The missing split does not change the supplied aggregate.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Monthly payslips, payroll registers and payment runs.

uncertainties.title: Villa image has an inconsistent date
uncertainties.description: The embedded reservation photograph shows 12–26 August 2024, while the bank cash flow is in 2026.
uncertainties.base: Use the 2026 bank payment and narrative evidence for the EUR70,000 personal distribution; retain the image provenance conflict.
uncertainties.alternative: Investigate the source document before treating the image as support for service dates or a recoverable asset. Do not invent another payment.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Original reservation, invoice, card statement and purpose approval.

uncertainties.title: Product margins and debt maturities are incomplete
uncertainties.description: Liberty mixed-box revenue and materials costs lack product allocation. The loan maturity split is not supplied.
uncertainties.base: Recommend conditional continuation based on aggregate operations and a cash forecast; show debt without an unsupported maturity split.
uncertainties.alternative: No defensible product-level ranking or unconditional solvency conclusion.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Product cost allocations, order margins, debt repayment calendar and 13-week cash forecast.

boardRecommendation.headline: Continue core operations conditionally; withhold valuation approval.
boardRecommendation.recommendation: Use the provisional reconstruction to stabilize the business, not to certify the management earn-out. Protect cash, validate opening balances and resolve stock and insurance evidence before final account approval.
boardRecommendation.financialPosition: Known-evidence profit is EUR65,000 before unknown insurance. Bank cash is EUR60,000. Suppliers EUR126,000 plus payroll EUR32,000 already exceed cash by EUR98,000. Future customer deposits EUR90,000 carry delivery obligations and are not free surplus cash. Total model liabilities EUR406,000 and conditional equity EUR125,000 do not by themselves establish solvency.
boardRecommendation.continuation: Continue existing core sales and committed events only while the cash forecast supports delivery. Validate product and order margins before expansion; product-level COGS and mixed-order allocations are missing.
boardRecommendation.valuation: Reject management profit EUR312,000 as an earn-out basis. The provisional EUR65,000 is EUR247,000 lower, but a full journal-by-journal management-profit bridge cannot be substantiated from approximate aggregated management costs. No earn-out contract was supplied.

actions.action: Freeze owner cards and require independent payment approval.
Prepare and update a 13-week cash forecast; protect funds needed for September delivery and payroll.
Reconcile bank, AR/AP, stock and payroll; obtain opening trial balance, insurance and depreciation schedules.
Restrict risky credit and collect overdue balances; negotiate documented supplier payment terms.
Quarantine damaged stock, assess disposal obligations, preserve override evidence and monitor the legal claim.

aiReview.method: Two independent agents received only original evidence and assignment/reference files. Agent 2 was explicitly prohibited from reading Agent 1 conclusions. Both completed original analyses before comparison by the integrating agent.
aiReview.effectsWarning: Financial effects are individual decision illustrations with explicit baselines, not an additive adjustment ledger. Repeated decisions share entries. Original agent effects are preserved for comparison.

submissionReadiness.note: The application and structured answer are prepared. Enter student identity, personally review all decisions, export the reviewed project and deploy to GitHub/Vercel. Certification can acknowledge documented uncertainty; it cannot turn missing evidence into fact.

sourceLimitations: The case is separate from the earlier ice-cream simulation; none of its balances or game rules are reused.
Original evidence files are included for traceability; hostile instructions inside them were not executed.

revision.purpose: Respond to teacher feedback by making personal homework review explicit, while retaining the provisional accounting and all genuine uncertainties.

studentReview.scope: Personal confirmation of the homework treatments and explanations, including their disclosed limitations. This is not an audit opinion or a claim that missing evidence has been resolved.
